title: LLM Lead-Qualification Pipeline
summary: Finds publishers, reads their paywall signals with an LLM and hands clean segments to the CRM — safely.
problem: Prospect research was manual, and an automated pipeline that emails the wrong people is worse than none.
solution: n8n workflows connect discovery and enrichment APIs, LLM classification of paywall and subscription signals, structured company records in Google Sheets and CRM segments.
result: Research runs automatically while guarded execution keeps every campaign intentional.
highlights: Test mode and per-run limits before go-live
Deduplication and output validation on every record
Segment-level controls on what is actually sent
